evidence.detail: PR 'Dark mode toggle' merged 2024-06-10, commit b4222baa
prefersDarkMode() checks localStorage.getItem('prefersDarkMode') first, falling back to OS preference — persists user choice
dark-mode-toggle-container li with toggle link is present in the main menu
initDarkModeToggle() sets localStorage.setItem('prefersDarkMode', ...) on click, fulfilling the toggle request

triage.notes: The issue is still open despite being resolved by #12756. Can be closed.
triage.proposed_comment: This was implemented in PR #12756 (merged June 2024). A dark mode toggle now appears at the bottom of the main menu and persists your preference in localStorage, overriding the OS default.
